Here's my (probably very crappy) prime number generator. I didn't really look at any theory when I was making it, so it's probably quite bad. But just in case anyone needs a small program:

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <limits.h>

bool is_prime(const unsigned long long int);

int main(void)
{
 puts("2\n3");

 for (unsigned long long int n = 5; n < ULLONG_MAX; n+=2) {
 if (is_prime(n)) {
 printf("%llu\n", n);
 }
 }
}

bool is_prime(const unsigned long long int n)
{
 if (n < 4) {
 return n > 1;
 } else if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) {
 return false;
 } else {
 for (unsigned long int i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
 if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) {
 return false;
 }
 }

 return true;
 }
}
